The '''Yhuli system''' was a part of the [[Jospro sector/Legends|Jospro sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point by [[25,200 BBY]],<ref name="25200 BBY">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' establishes that the [[Kwa/Legends|Kwa]] [[Star/Legends|interstellar]] civilization had been destroyed by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] at some point by [[25,200 BBY]].</ref> the [[Kwa/Legends|Kwa]],<ref name="Relics of the Kwa" /> [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]<ref name="TEA" /> in the [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]],<ref name="EAOC Dathomir">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Dathomir system/Legends|Dathomir system]]</ref> constructed a [[Yhuli system Star Temple|Star Temple]]<ref name="Relics of the Kwa" />&mdash;one of a series of [[Star Temple|structures]] built to house the [[Infinity Gate]] devices used by the Kwa for faster-than-light travel<ref name="TEA" />&mdash;in the Yhuli [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="Relics of the Kwa" /> By [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="2 ABY">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the Yhuli system also contained the facility known as [[Yhuli Docking Port 32]].<ref name="AIR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Yhuli system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square R-7.<ref name="TEA" />
